title: Pocketwire Rewards Terms for Bonuses and Member Referrals
content:
Pocketwire Rewards credits bonus points for member referrals, and bonus points follow the same pending period as any other earning. The tier figures named here are the tier's referral bonus, yearly referral limit, qualifying card spend and qualifying days, and pending period.

## Clauses in force

1. A referral bonus of the tier's referral bonus points is credited when the referred customer, whose profile was created through the member's referral, reached the tier's qualifying card spend in card purchases within the tier's qualifying days in calendar days after sign-up.
2. Referral bonuses are credited at most the tier's yearly referral limit times per calendar year, counted as the membership's referral bonus entries dated in the calendar year containing the handling date.
3. Referring oneself or a second profile of the same person is rewards abuse and earns nothing.
4. A referral is rewarded once per referred customer, bonuses are credited while the membership is active, and bonus points are subject to the pending period like any other earning.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The former clause under which the quarterly milestone bonus of the tier's milestone bonus points, at the tier held on the last day of a quarter, was credited once for that quarter when the quarter's qualifying spend reached the tier's milestone threshold is no longer in force.
- The former clause under which the anniversary bonus of the tier's anniversary bonus points was credited on each anniversary of the enrolment date while the membership is active is no longer in force.
- The former clause under which a bonus was credited only if no earlier bonus entry of the same bonus type existed for the same bonus period is no longer in force.

They are superseded by the current bases for the quarterly milestone bonus and for the anniversary bonus.

## Referral outcomes (hypothetical referrals)

| Referred customer | Qualifying spend reached in time | Yearly limit already reached | Same person as the member | Referral bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| New customer referred by the member | Yes | No | No | credited once |
| New customer referred by the member | Yes | Yes | No | not credited this calendar year |
| A second profile of the member | Yes | No | Yes | nothing, rewards abuse |

## Points of judgement

- A referred customer who is already rewarded once earns the member no second referral bonus.
- A referral bonus credited today stays pending for the tier's pending period, like points earned on a purchase.
